name: ObjectDatabase++
tagline: Ekky Software's embedded C++ object database with B+tree, spatial, full-text and pattern indexes.
description: ObjectDatabase++ (ODBPP) is an embedded object-oriented database library from Ekky Software for C++ developers, with an ATL/COM interface for VB.NET and C#, aimed at people who want direct control over storage instead of a SQL server. It supports multi-process and multi-threaded servers with full transaction control, real-time recovery and online compaction, 64-bit object IDs, and a set of built-in index types: B+tree, spatial, token (full-text), variable and biometric pattern-matching indexes. A free GUI editor and the TScript scripting language round out the toolkit, and developers can use each monthly build free under a renewable three-month key. The product is small and obscure but alive: SDK 4.8.0 for 64-bit Windows was published on August 1, 2026.

pricing.notes: Monthly builds carry a free three-month developer key; deployment licensing through Ekky Software.

strengths: Unusual built-in index types: spatial, full-text and biometric pattern matching
Multi-process access with real-time recovery and online compaction
weaknesses: Very small vendor and user community
Windows-first tooling; COM interface feels dated
Proprietary with licensing that is not clearly documented
useCases: C++ applications that need embedded object storage with spatial indexes
Windows server components wanting custom index types
